# Harbor Tile & Carpet Cleaning

> Your Sparkle Specialists! Tile and grout, carpet, rugs, upholstery and yacht interior cleaning for Palm Beach County homes.

Harbor Tile & Carpet Cleaning is a locally owned West Palm Beach company, run by Jennifer and Jonny, that cleans tile and grout, carpet, area rugs, upholstery and yacht interiors and removes pet stains and odors, from Deerfield Beach to Jupiter. It has 240 five-star Google reviews. Call or text (561) 301-1977, Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

- Phone: (561) 301-1977
- Email: service@harbortc.com
- Address: 500 S Australian Ave #600, West Palm Beach, FL 33401
- Service area: Jupiter, Palm Beach Gardens, Palm Beach, West Palm Beach, Wellington, Boynton Beach, Delray Beach, Boca Raton, Deerfield Beach, Palm Beach County
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM. Closed Sunday.
- Owner: Jennifer
- Owner: Jonny

## Services
- [Tile & Grout Cleaning](https://harbortc.com/tile-grout-cleaning/): Machine agitation and hot-water extraction that lift soil, grease and soap scum out of tile and grout, with optional grout sealing, for kitchens, baths, entries and patios.
- [Carpet Cleaning](https://harbortc.com/carpet-cleaning/): Deep extraction for wall-to-wall carpet with a 7-step process that removes embedded soil and traffic lanes without leaving a sticky residue.
- [Area Rug Cleaning](https://harbortc.com/area-rug-cleaning/): In-home or off-site cleaning for synthetic, wool, viscose, oriental and silk area rugs.
- [Upholstery Cleaning](https://harbortc.com/upholstery-cleaning/): Fabric-safe cleaning for sofas, sectionals, dining chairs, mattresses and outdoor cushions.
- [Pet Stain & Odor Removal](https://harbortc.com/pet-stain-odor-removal/): Enzyme treatment and UV detection for pet stains and odors in carpet, rugs, upholstery and tile.
- [Yacht Interior Cleaning](https://harbortc.com/yacht-interior-cleaning/): Discreet cleaning for salons, staterooms, carpet, upholstery and mattresses aboard, including Harbor Shield protection.
